Triage tasks: list, show, set, brief

Move tasks through the triage states needs-triage, needs-info, ready-for-agent, ready-for-human and wontfix (docs/agents/triage-labels.md). State and category live in the task notes and every transition leaves a system comment. Invalid transitions exit 1 and change nothing.

```sh
woco triage <subcommand> [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |

## triage set

Move a task to a triage state

```sh
woco triage set <task> <state> [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `task` | yes | Task ID |
| `state` | yes | Target state [needs-triage\|needs-info\|ready-for-agent\|ready-for-human\|wontfix] |

### Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--category` |  | string |  | Category: bug or enhancement |
| `--comment` |  | string |  | Comment recorded with the transition |
| `--author` |  | string |  | Author (default: WOMBO_AUTHOR, git user.email, OS user) |
| `--reopen` |  | boolean | `false` | Allow wontfix -&gt; needs-triage |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Skip the transition table (maintainer override) |
